title: Portfolio v2: RAII and the rule of three
summary: Refactor chapter 3's struct-and-functions portfolio into a class that owns its array: constructor, destructor, private growth, then deep copies. Client code can no longer forget to release memory.

steps.title: A class that cleans up after itself
hints: Private members: `int size_, capacity_; Position* positions_;`. Allocate in the constructor, `delete[]` in the destructor.
Keep `grow()` private: it's an implementation detail.

steps.title: Copyable portfolios
hints: Copy constructor: allocate `capacity_` positions and copy the `size_` used ones.
Assignment: copy-and-swap, as in Tableau v4.
